name: kori-kalaga
description: Kori Kalaga: a village rooster game for Android and iOS (no gambling, no real-money prizes)

scripts.game: cp source/base.html src/game.html && python3 source/patch_3d.py src/game.html
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
